content.text:
Yes, Firecrawl has had a few short incidents, mostly degraded performance rather than full outages. All of them affected the API.

**From Firecrawl's official status page (most recent first):**
- **Sep 15, 2026:** incident #1064335. The page shows no details or duration.
- **Sep 5:** `/scrape` latency degraded for about 46 minutes.
- **Sep 3:** `/scrape` degraded for about 7 minutes.
- **Aug 26:** the API was degraded for about 16 minutes.
- **Jul 20:** the `/interact` API `prompt` field was degraded for about 56 minutes.

The status page header says "All services are online." It also shows the Interact endpoint as degraded for 44 minutes, so those two don't agree. The page doesn't state how each incident ended.

**From third-party trackers:**
- Pingoru's snapshot reports 8 incidents in 90 days and 97.78% uptime. It says the latest incident was resolved 23 days before the snapshot.
- StatusGator lists 2 incidents in the last 30 days. One was a 16-minute "login and API access" issue that Firecrawl never officially acknowledged.

These snapshots are undated or older than the status page, so I couldn't confirm whether there's anything happening today. For the live state, check the official status page directly.

Sources:
- [Firecrawl status history](https://status.firecrawl.dev/history)
- [Pingoru: Firecrawl outage history](https://pingoru.io/providers/firecrawl/outage-history)
- [StatusGator: Firecrawl](https://statusgator.com/services/firecrawl)
- [Entireweb: Firecrawl status](https://www.entireweb.com/status/firecrawl)
